BTC_utc0_k2.0.rule: MBT (BTCUSDT perp as proxy), 5-min bars. Session = day anchored at 00:00 UTC. tp = (high+low+close)/3; vwap = cumulative sum(volume*tp)/sum(volume) within the session; sd = volume-weighted st.dev. of tp around VWAP within the session (sqrt(sum(v*tp^2)/sum(v) - vwap^2)); z = (close - vwap)/sd. Signal at the close of bar i when |z[i]| >= 2.0 and |z[i-1]| < 2.0 (fresh crossing), at least 12 bars into the session, and |close - vwap| >= 3 x round-trip cost / 0.1 = $114.6. Enter at the open of bar i+1, side = -sign(z) (long below VWAP, short above). Exit at the open of bar j+1 when at the close of bar j: |z[j]| <= 0.2 or z changed sign (back at VWAP), or |z[j]| >= 3.5 (soft stop), or bar j is the last bar of the session; otherwise exit at the open of the bar 48 bars (240 min) after entry, or at the 15:10 CT Topstep flat if earlier. No fixed stop/target. One position at a time; entries only when the next bar is inside Topstep hours (not 15:08-17:00 CT, no weekend).
